question: Do actual public EMC specimen-linked oxygenation/hypoxia measurements support an unanswered useful within-donor viable-tumor versus normal/metastatic/treatment-compartment contrast beyond published gene-expression programs?
prevalue_action: Authenticate identity, measurement, all specimen/condition maps and primary prior-art/public access first. No outcome/assay values inspected until a genuine linked source and one consequential unreported comparison are frozen additively. Initial25-minute source/value gate, not a numerical stage.
population: Every identifiable genuine EMC specimen/model/condition in relevant public tissue cohorts and measurements. Generic chondrosarcoma/sarcoma is unresolved, not EMC; source pathology/fusion support and historicaldiagnosis limits explicit. Multiple cores/ROI/timepoints are conditions not independent donors.

measurement_rule.direct: Measured tissue oxygen tension/oxygen-sensitive probe/tracer retention or source-validated direct assay; oxygenation, perfusion and viable fraction remain separate endpoints.
measurement_rule.metabolic: Measured lactate is contextual metabolism, not a specific oxygen tension or hypoxia measurement. Compartment/method/handling and alternatives required.
measurement_rule.proxy: CAIX or HIF1alpha IHC is tissue-protein proxy, not direct oxygen; preserve source assay, antibody, cutoff, nuclear/membrane/cellular compartment, ischemia/fixation, source oncogenic regulation and viable/necrotic distinctions.
measurement_rule.excluded_inferences: RNA expression/predicted scores are not measured oxygenation. FDG PET is not a hypoxia-specific tracer. Predictions, model/generic disease, photographs, unrelated tumor cohorts and source title alone cannot replace EMC measurement.

conditional_unanswered_contrast: Same-donor, same-assay, independently mapped viable EMC compartments before/after treatment or primary/metastasis versus matched normal context, with perfusion/viability/preservation controls; whichever one actual source supports would be frozen before outcomes, with all source EMC conditions retained. No unpaired favorable assay examples or marker-panel rescue.
use: A replicated oxygen-specific or carefully calibrated proxy contrast might identify a meaningful measurement for radiotherapy/metabolic tissue study; it does not prove target dependency, immune causality, therapeutic sensitivity or efficacy.
prior_art_gate: Reuse current EMC published RNA and tissue context; search actual primary CAIX/HIF/lactate/O2/hypoxia-PET tissue assays, broader sarcoma cohorts and historical aliases. Any already reported exact contrast or generic diagnostic marker prevalence cannot become a new publication finding.
controls: Prefer all identifiable same-donor matched assay controls; preserve all measured comparator/subtype/normal/treatment conditions. Unmatched carcinoma or other sarcoma may be contextual only, never substitute paired EMC evidence or prove safety. Comparator eligibility by source/assay/conditions, never positive values.
strongest_alternatives: Post-excision ischemia, fixation/preservation and antigen retrieval alter HIF/CAIX
Oncogenic or lineage regulation causes proxy positivity despite oxygen status
Low perfusion or necrosis/viable fraction alters tracer retention independent of cellular oxygen consumption
Lactate from handling/glycolytic programs or stromal compartments is not hypoxia-specific
Unmatched tissue/site/grade/treatment or source batch explains apparent contrast
Repeated cores/ROIs/resections or cohort overlap inflate independent evidence
stop: No genuine linked EMC tissue oxygenation/proxy source with useful comparator stops this route at source gate; unknown cases/access remain pending, not absentbiology.
No public specimen-condition crosswalk or suitable measurement leaves relevant evidence pending/unavailable, not scientifically excluded for size/time.
Already published contrast/diagnostic prevalence, assay onlyRNA or weak unpaired surrogate result does not justify a standalone paper.
No meaningful source-supported distinct question and discriminating controls => no numerical stage, no manuscript.
coverage: All identifiable relevant publicEMC sources/conditions mandatory; status evaluated/verifiedreuse/pendingaccessible/demonstrablyunsuitable/unavailable explicit; suitablepending blockspromotion. Independent challenge needed beforeadvancement.
